title: Change Registered Office (Within City)
description: Board approval to shift the registered office to a new address within the same city, town or village.
records: Proof of the new address (utility bill and NOC / lease)

questions.label: How many clear days' notice was given for this meeting?
questions.tooltip: Section 173(3) requires at least 7 clear days' written notice to every director.

questions.label: How many directors are present at this meeting?

template.agendaTitle: To change the registered office of the Company within the local limits of the city
template.proposal: The Board considered shifting the registered office from {{old_address}} to {{new_address}}, within the same city, with effect from {{effective_date}}. The Board members discussed and approved the following resolution.
template.body:
"RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 12 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014, the registered office of the Company be shifted from {{old_address}} to {{new_address}}, being within the local limits of the same city, town or village, with effect from {{effective_date}}.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any one Director or the Company Secretary be and is hereby authorised to file Form INC-22 with the Registrar of Companies within thirty days of the change, along with the required attachments, and to update all statutory records and the Company's letterheads and documents accordingly."
template.minutesGist: Meeting held on {{meeting_date}} at {{meeting_place}}. The Board considered shifting the registered office from {{old_address}} to {{new_address}} within the same city with effect from {{effective_date}}, and approved the resolution above.

new_address.meaning: The full postal address of the new registered office.
new_address.tip: A shift to another city or state needs separate procedures (shareholder approval and, for another state, regional director / NCLT approval) not covered here.
